name: frontier-operations
status: SYNTHETIC_MODEL_ONLY; no AzerothCore content, module, SQL, addon, assets, or gameplay integration is implemented

vertical.title: The Surveyor's Last Route
vertical.setting_candidate: Un'Goro Crater; all exact locations, creatures, objects, text, and display assets require local build-12340 verification
player_loop: Investigate three field sites in any order; each site is visited once and grants a server-validated clue.
Rescue a missing surveyor after all three clues are recorded.
Activate two field beacons as a bounded, objective-based defense; no real-time waiting or kill quota is required.
Choose one deterministic regional outcome: restore a route or archive the findings.
Receive an abstract completion proof; actual reward identities and delivery remain unimplemented and unverified.
vertical.experience_goal: Make an existing large open zone playable as a short exploration/rescue/defense mission without new maps, art, scheduled availability, or repeated grind.
vertical.solo_and_group: Designed for one through five real players, but party credit, Playerbot participation, and shared progression are not implemented or qualified. The reference model represents one character-owned operation only.
reward_policy: Outcome choice is deterministic and mutually exclusive.
No random reward roll, daily reset, auction-house requirement, paid-like convenience, or real-time lockout.
No item, currency, quest, or inventory reward is granted by the reference model.

transitions.guard: site is approved and not already recorded; any order
transitions.effect: add one validated clue; after exactly three distinct clues, enter RESCUE

transitions.guard: surveyor is rescued; beacon is approved and not already activated
transitions.effect: record two distinct beacon proofs; no kill count or wall-clock timer
persist one immutable choice and completion proof

mutation_safety: Every successful mutation is bound to an expected state revision and unique request ID.
A retry with the same request ID and identical action replays the prior receipt without a second mutation.
Reusing a request ID for a different action is rejected.
A stale revision is rejected rather than merged implicitly.

The Python reference is single-process, in-memory and sequential; production persistence must enforce idempotency, revision checks, state transitions, and reward grants transactionally in AzerothCore-owned storage.

authority_and_integration.azerothcore: Must own objective validation, persistent operation state, quest/item/inventory/reward authority, and concurrent-safe idempotent mutations.
authority_and_integration.playerbots: Own bot navigation, combat, and execution. This mission makes no claim that bots can traverse the chosen area or operate any chosen object.
authority_and_integration.campaign_party: Own party identity, permissions, membership changes, and command routing. No party API or schema is assumed by this design.
authority_and_integration.addon: May display progress and submit untrusted intent only; it cannot authoritatively award clues, completion, or rewards.
authority_and_integration.assets: Use only stock assets verified against supplied build-12340 data; no numeric asset IDs are specified or claimed. Keep user-owned patches untouched.

implementation_order: Review stock zone content and select usable survey sites, a rescue location, beacons, and text using local data; record source evidence for every ID.
Agree on a downstream-safe character/party ownership and migration contract without inventing Campaign Party APIs.
Implement server-authoritative persistent state and idempotent objective/reward transactions in AzerothCore-owned storage.
Generate SQL/addon/module artifacts only after schemas, IDs, install order, ownership, conflict checks, migration, rollback, and compatibility are reviewed.
Qualify in layers: synthetic model, static/schema checks, disposable DB apply/reapply/rollback, pinned-core compile, then real client/server/Playerbot/party acceptance.
acceptance: All three sites can be completed in any order; duplicate site completion cannot grant an additional clue.
Rescue, defense, and outcome choice cannot be performed before their prerequisites.
Two approved beacons complete the defense objective without a real-time wait or kill-count gate.
Duplicate identical request retries produce one state transition; conflicting request-ID reuse and stale revisions are rejected.
Outcome choice is saved once and cannot be silently replaced; no unverified item or currency is granted.
A restart, concurrent mutation, rollback, inventory failure, party membership change, and bot execution are explicitly tested before live qualification.
